Validation occurs before unchanged-worktree cleanup; saved verified metadata remains historical evidence after those files are removed.

Finish preserves the latest assistant response observed in events even if the session's message array is replaced. It accounts assistant/compaction usage, appends nonzero subagent_usage before the durable turn-settled record, and backfills missing older usage once from persisted totals. Saved lastResult replaces prior output only after durable transition; capture failure is explicit artifact_unavailable. Interrupted restore does not serve an earlier verified snapshot as the new turn's result.
certified_entry_comparisons.interfaces: V2ResultObservations before(tool,args),after(token,success),verifyPath; normalizeV2Acceptance; validateV2Result; renderV2ResultInstructions. Validation contains reportMode,verified,assurance,reason,paths,requirements,findings?,payload?. Requirements retain required=true,claim,verified and semanticVerified=false. No independent reviewer or test runner is part of this validation.

certified_entry_comparisons.title: Owner-scoped output artifacts, UTF-8 range reads and durable retention
certified_entry_comparisons.mechanism:
The store redacts captured output, keeps a bounded inline prefix, and writes larger output behind an owner-scoped UUID. Registry retention determines when the artifact remains durable or can be reclaimed.

Default inline cap48KiB,per-artifact4MiB,read default16KiB/max64KiB,owner quota16MiB and store-global quota128MiB. Quotas are in-memory accounting for this store instance, not a filesystem-wide synchronized quota. originalBytes counts raw input; stored redaction can increase bytes. Inline text is a UTF-8 prefix without a marker. Small output returns inline_complete; large output returns artifact_complete or artifact_truncated; capacity/storage failure preserves inline text with artifact_unavailable. Metadata validates schemaVersion2,UUIDv4,positive storedBytes<=4MiB,nonnegative originalBytes,64hex SHA,plain/json content type,truncated boolean and no unknown keys. No arbitrary filesystem path is accepted in the reference.

Resolve storage under agentDir/artifacts/subagent-output/SHA256(ownerSessionId)/uuid/output.txt or output.json; owner ID1..512bytes and root path<=4096. Refuse symlink components/canonical escape, create private directories0700 and exclusive O_NOFOLLOW regular file, then mode0400. This capture path does not fsync file/directory, so a durable registry reference is not a guarantee of power-loss persistence of artifact bytes. Read opens the owned regular file with no-follow,checks dev/ino and bounded size,reads and verifies exact stored length,SHA and UTF-8 round trip before returning any chunk. A concurrent file growth after fstat can still cause readFileSync to read more than the prechecked size before integrity failure; do not claim descriptor read is allocation-bounded by that earlier stat.

read requires safe integer offset>=0,length1..65536 and owned known UUID; cross-owner and unknown IDs share the same not-found error. Offset must be on a UTF-8 boundary, end backs up to a boundary, and a requested length too short for the next code point rejects. EOF offset==stored length returns an empty final chunk. Reply includes nextOffset,totalBytes,bytesRead,eof,contentType,SHA,truncated. Runtime applies equivalent range checks to inline data; public agent_control length max49152 is a narrower schema bound.

References are idempotent logical owners. capture ownership can be promoted to durable:v2:childID; retainDurable removes the capture ref. release removes only the exact matching ref, and deletes the file only when none remain; it removes accounting before best-effort cleanup. dispose drops process-local refs while preserving durable ones. Restore registers each persisted reference only after ownership/integrity/capacity checks, downgrades invalid saved artifacts explicitly, then finalizeRestore sweeps unregistered UUID children for that owner, deleting only known plain output files and preserving unexpected contents/other owners. It does not discover all owners for global quota accounting. Replacing the latest durable child result releases its predecessor after the new record is durable; deletion releases the current ref.
certified_entry_comparisons.interfaces: SubagentOutputArtifactStore capture,read,retain,retainDurable,registerDurable,release,finalizeRestore,dispose. Output {text,textBytes,originalBytes,inlineTruncated,captureStatus,artifact?}; artifact {schemaVersion:2,id,storedBytes,originalBytes,sha256,contentType,truncated}. Errors artifact_not_found|artifact_invalid|artifact_integrity_failure|artifact_offset_invalid|artifact_storage_failure. Legacy schemaVersion1 report artifacts are a separate retained helper.

certified_entry_comparisons.title: Deterministic assurance helpers and bounded batch synthesis
certified_entry_comparisons.mechanism:
The assurance library is pure and performs no I/O. Levels are unverified_plain, evidence_checked, criteria_verified, verification_executed and review_verified.

A plain_final_turn is always unverified_plain. Otherwise reviewerVerified wins independently; then an observed and successful verification command; then all required criteria verified; then evidence checked; otherwise unverified. These are precedence rules, not a requirement that every lower level also be true. V2 uses the level/render helpers with its observed-file verifier; it does not wire the library's generic command/diff-claim verifiers into the active child result path.

Generic evidence validation checks lexically normalized paths against exact observed paths, artifacts against owned IDs, commands after collapsing whitespace against observed command/optional claimed exit status, and every diff path against the owned changed-path set. An empty diff path list verifies vacuously; undefined ownership data leaves a diff unverified. not_run is always verified as reporting uncertainty. Unknown/unobserved claims are fabricated; precision is verified descriptors divided by total, or zero when empty. Implementation claims first enforce optional lexical workspace containment, then compare modified paths to the patch and commands to observed command/status pairs. Reasons are outside_workspace, not_in_patch, not_observed and exit_status_mismatch. This library neither canonicalizes filesystem paths nor executes a verifier. Assurance rendering sorts IDs, redacts strings, caps each item at256 UTF-8 bytes, lists8 mismatches per kind and caps the section at2048 bytes with a UTF-8-safe truncation marker.

The duplicate-task helper compares whitespace-normalized task text, sorted scope roots/targets, kind and deliverable, retaining the first occurrence. It ignores model/tool differences and is not called by V2 launch: do not add a live duplicate-rejection rule on the strength of this exported helper. Active V2 synthesis projects checked validation state; criterion identity is based on redacted, trimmed, whitespace-normalized lowercase criterion text rather than task-local positional IDs. The generic synthesizer itself joins requirement states by their supplied IDs.

Synthesis sorts tasks lexically and counts completed/failed/other, verified/unresolved criteria and original evidence-path array length. Pairwise overlap is exact-path set intersection, sorted and capped at16 paths per pair. A finding contradiction is a high-severity same normalized category with opposing substring-based polarity; negative markers include no , not , cannot, unable, missing and absent. This heuristic is not semantic review. Requirement contradictions preserve a shared criterion with differing verified booleans. Contradictions sort by task pair, kind and identity and cap at32; emitted summaries redact and cap at200 Unicode code points. Results are deeply frozen. Rendering is deterministic, capped at4096 UTF-8 bytes with a marker, and explicitly preserves disagreement for the parent instead of averaging it away.
certified_entry_comparisons.interfaces: deriveSubagentAssuranceLevel, validateSubagentEvidenceClaims, validateSubagentImplementationClaims, renderSubagentAssuranceSection; findExactDuplicateBatchTasks, summarizeBatchSynthesis, renderBatchSynthesisSection. These exported library contracts and the narrower V2 call sites must remain separately identifiable.

certified_entry_comparisons.title: Raw dirty-tree snapshots and owned isolated Git worktrees
certified_entry_comparisons.mechanism:
The Git wrapper uses literal execFileSync argv with a60s timeout, ordinarily9MiB maxBuffer and a larger260MiB cat-file bound. It removes inherited GIT_* environment variables; disables prompts, system/global Git configuration, system attributes, lazy fetch, hooks, fsmonitor, untracked cache, split index and merge renormalization, and supplies synthetic author identity.

Local repository configuration still exists; external merge drivers are rejected separately during apply. It never invokes the user's shell for Git.

Require a repository with HEAD. Enumerate cached stage-zero entries and nonignored untracked files, rejecting unmerged entries, submodules/gitlinks and nested repositories. Sort their union; omit missing tracked paths. Reject empty/NUL paths, empty/dot/dotdot segments, case-insensitive .git segments, lexical escapes, symlink ancestors and nested repository ancestors. Leaf symlinks are allowed in the baseline as raw link-target bytes; regular-file contents and executable bits are captured without clean filters, text conversion or newline normalization. The snapshot includes untracked raw bytes, CRLF, non-UTF-8 contents and unusual names. Limit a snapshot to20000 files/256MiB, including an untracked subset at20000 files/64MiB. Check sizes before reads and recheck content length against the stat. Compute expected Git blob IDs for SHA-1 or SHA-256 repositories; compare hash-object results to detect content drift. Newline-containing names and symlinks use per-object stdin paths instead of line-oriented batching.

Build a tree with an owned temporary index using read-tree --empty, update-index -z and write-tree, then remove that temporary index. The real index is untouched. A synthetic commit uses the captured tree and HEAD parent; retain cwd offset within the repository. Child worktree destination must be absent, outside the parent, and free of symlink components. Write a private adjacent .ice-owner.json before git worktree add --detach --no-checkout. Materialize raw blobs/modes/link targets, initialize its index to the baseline and recapture to verify equality; failures clean up owned state.

Ownership validation requires matching repository/path/baseline marker and an exact git worktree list entry. The marker is read without an explicit byte cap. Pin the worktree snapshot under refs/ice/subagent-v2/worktrees/<SHA256(resolved path)> for Git GC retention. Cleanup force-removes only an owned worktree, then its ref and marker. The force behavior may delete child edits on explicit rejection, but ordinary pruning first checks for changes.

Delta generation uses no-renames name-status -z and binary patch output with external diff/textconv/color disabled. Limit changed paths to512 and patch bytes to8MiB. Keep both raw patch bytes and display text; lossy text is not the integrity source. File-to-directory and directory-to-file replacements are unsupported. Index identity is SHA-256 over its raw bytes. Snapshotting may write Git objects and temporary indexes even when a caller merely asks whether a worktree changed.
certified_entry_comparisons.interfaces: captureWorktreeBaseline, createIsolatedWorktree, snapshotWorktree, computeChildDelta, deltaFromTree, worktreeHasChanges, removeIsolatedWorktree, assertOwnedWorktree, readWorktreeOwner, worktreeSnapshotRef and worktreeIndexHash. WorktreeBaseline carries repoRoot, headCommit, baselineCommit, baselineTree and cwd offset; ChildDelta carries final tree, changed statuses/paths, raw patch bytes and lossy display text. Index hashing is a separate operation.

certified_entry_comparisons.title: Pinned immutable patch artifacts and private recovery records
certified_entry_comparisons.mechanism:
Place patch artifacts outside both parent and child worktrees and reject symlink components. Create the artifact directory privately0700.

The filename combines final tree and patch SHA as <finalTree>-<patchsha>.patch. Create an exclusive0444 file, fsync it and fsync its directory on non-Windows. If the exact file already exists, require a regular file with identical raw bytes; never replace mismatching data. Pin a synthetic final-tree commit whose parent is the baseline commit under the owned worktree GC ref.

Persist finalTree, baselineTree, contractHash, patchRef, patchSha256 and patchBytes with the child's patch state. Validation checks the filename form, a40–64 hex final-tree identity, baseline and contract equality, regular file type, size<=8MiB, recorded length and SHA-256, then regenerates the tree delta and requires byte-for-byte equality. Model-visible display text is not used to validate or apply the patch. Inspect establishes this pinned artifact; a controller preview merely computes a delta and does not satisfy the inspect-before-apply requirement.

Before parent writes, the apply layer can durably write a private UUID.recovery.json containing base64 preimages and transaction metadata at0600, with file/directory fsync. This is recovery evidence, not model context. The runtime persists the applying state before mutation and commits the terminal applied state before discarding recovery preimages. Restart can recognize open/terminal worktree state and perform terminal cleanup, but the audited code does not automatically replay or roll back an interrupted applying transaction. Do not turn a recovery record into an unreviewed restart mutation.
certified_entry_comparisons.interfaces: persistWorktreePatch, validateWorktreePatch and persistPatchRecovery; WorktreePatchArtifact {finalTree,baselineTree,contractHash,patchRef,patchSha256,patchBytes}. agent_patch action inspect|apply|reject with a child id/name reference matching CHILD_REF_PATTERN_SOURCE; no additional schema properties.

certified_entry_comparisons.title: Authorized patch integration, verification and conflict-preserving rollback
certified_entry_comparisons.mechanism:
Runtime apply requires a trusted parent in build mode, active agent_patch, an open patch and explicit allow for every affected parent write; ask is not silently approved. It validates the inspected artifact and rejects child changes made after inspection.

Parent authority is checked before preparation, immediately before writing and after verification. Resume/delete are blocked while integration is in progress. A failed verification reopens the patch; applied/empty parks the child with best-effort cleanup. Reject records its terminal state before owned force-removal.

The integration helper obtains a synthetic repository lock through the shared in-process mutation queue, then sorted individual path locks. These coordinate application tools, not unrelated OS writers. An empty delta returns empty. Reject out-of-scope/protected paths, symlink leaves in baseline/final state, unsupported file/directory replacements and configured external Git merge drivers. Capture real-index hash and current raw parent tree. If the parent diverged from the child baseline, construct ours/theirs commits with a common baseline and use git merge-tree --write-tree --no-messages --merge-base; a conflict returns bounded4096-character diagnostics before parent writes. The resulting changed paths must be a subset of the child's delta; no new merge-introduced paths are accepted.

Capture regular-file preimages with raw blob/mode checks. Preserve existing non-executable mode bits while taking the resulting Git executable bit; the tests include0600→0711. Combined preimage/postimage bytes must fit16MiB. Under locks recheck index and preimages; drift before writes returns changed_during_apply with the path or Git index. Reauthorize, then invoke beforeWrite to durably publish recovery data/applying state. For each path, recheck expected current contents and use an exclusive temporary file, chmod and rename, or delete the expected regular file. Track only writes that actually completed. Optional verification must return passed; afterward reauthorize and verify all postimages, unchanged real index and complete parent snapshot==result tree. Commit the durable applied result before discarding preimages. Without a verifier, successful apply remains unverified=true.

On any failure, walk completed writes in reverse. Restore only when current content still equals the transaction's expected postimage; a path already equal to its preimage needs no work. Preserve newer content and report rollback_conflict with affected paths rather than overwriting it. Otherwise report verification_failed after rollback. Do not restore a changed index or unrelated external writes; created empty directories may remain. Thus the contract is conflict-preserving best-effort file rollback, not an atomic repository transaction. Tests cover nonoverlapping dirty-parent merge, conflicts, verification rollback, index mutation during verification and newer-file preservation.
certified_entry_comparisons.interfaces: applyChildDelta with authorize,beforeWrite,verify,commit hooks; result statuses include empty, applied, conflict, changed_during_apply, verification_failed and rollback_conflict. agent_patch inspect|apply|reject returns normal tool text/details; external RPC execution must pass through the ordinary tool hooks rather than directly invoking the helper.

certified_entry_comparisons.title: Agent catalog CLI, definition creation and conservative orphan pruning
certified_entry_comparisons.mechanism:
The ice agents dispatch runs before normal startup and supports list [--json], validate [paths...] and prune [--apply] [--json]; unknown command/options return exit2. List returns0 and renders active/shadowed/disabled definitions and discovery issues, or equivalent JSON.

It does not fail the exit code for invalid settings and does not include settings diagnostics as a substitute for validation. Validate with no paths combines scoped settings diagnostics and invalid definitions: errors return1, deprecation warnings alone0, and an untrusted definition is not inherently malformed. Explicit non-flag paths are read and parsed as native user definitions; those reads have no additional CLI file-size bound, non-agent Markdown succeeds, invalid/unreadable files fail, and this branch does not also perform global catalog/settings validation.

Definition creation validates the native lowercase name, requires trust when creating in the project directory, refuses an existing destination, creates the directory and writes with wx so it never overwrites. Global creation has no extra project-trust requirement. The interactive /agents new command uses this helper.

Pruning scans one level of plain session directories beneath sessionsRoot. It collects live parent IDs by the filename pattern _([^_]+)\.jsonl$ across those directories, without an is-file test for the matching entry. It considers plain subagents/<parentId> folders orphaned only if that ID is absent everywhere. A recent folder or direct child mtime within10minutes holds the folder; this is not a recursive newest-descendant scan. It counts direct transcript JSONL files and worktree entries, excluding owner marker files. Every candidate worktree must be plain, have matching ownership metadata and have no delta from its baseline. Unknown, malformed, changed or failed worktrees hold the whole parent folder.

Default is deletion-free planning; --apply removes each verified owned clean worktree through Git, then removes the lexically direct orphan folder recursively. Partial failures become keep reasons and preserve the remainder. Other parents and changed worktrees are retained. The dry-run uses worktreeHasChanges→snapshotWorktree, which can write Git objects and a temporary index: it is not a fully read-only command, although it performs no planned deletions. The audit did not invoke it. The code checks the scanned entries, but does not establish that every ancestor of sessionsRoot is nonsymlink.
certified_entry_comparisons.interfaces: runAgentsCli returns {exitCode,stdout,stderr}; createAgentDefinitionFile; pruneOrphanedSubagents returns planned/kept folders, transcript/worktree counts and reasons. CLI --json exposes the same decisions; PRUNE_RECENT_MS=600000.

certified_entry_comparisons.title: SDK composition and versioned trusted-extension controller
certified_entry_comparisons.mechanism:
createIceSubagents builds a hidden inline ice-subagents extension at before-user priority, attaches an IceAgentViewBridge and exposes attach, overview and respondToApproval; subscriptions are available through the bridge. Options provide plan/build mode, explicit agents, host hook handlers, MCP adapter and agent directory; mode defaults to plan.

Early overview access must use the actual parent session settings and trust even before session_start, rather than constructing defaults. The wrapper does not independently require a persistent session before construction; the runtime's durable barrier rejects unsupported launches later. In headless build mode an ask permission fails closed without a foreground approval UI/inbox, while an explicit user allow rule may grant the corresponding write.

Trusted extensions find a version1 controller on their shared events owner using Symbol.for("ice.subagents.controller.v1"). Registration defines a configurable owner property and replaces any previous controller. Its cleanup removes the property only if it still points to the same controller, so stale cleanup cannot erase a replacement. No process-global singleton is required.

start accepts the agent task schema but forbids resume, checks an already-aborted signal, normalizes context into the prompt, calls the normal runtime launch/preflight/approval path, captures the resident frozen model and calls onLaunched before running. runTurn is foreground:true, returns directly to the caller and does not enqueue parent-conversation completion delivery. Return id, agent, frozen {provider,id}, outcome, bounded text/truncated/error, input/output/cache read/cache write/cost usage, optional patchState, verified structured payload and any validation findings. The signal is passed to runTurn but not runtime.launch: cancellation arriving during launch approval does not itself cancel that pending launch. A throwing onLaunched callback can leave an accepted resident child before its first turn; record that behavior instead of promising transactional callback cleanup.

stop delegates to runtime.stop. openPatches lists this owner's patchState=open children. preview computes the open child delta without inspecting/pinning it, returning worktree root, changed paths, display patch and truncated flag. The default cap is64KiB, implemented by raw-byte subarray followed by UTF-8 decoding, so it can replace a cut multibyte character; maxBytes is not independently schema-validated. Another child may read an owner's open patch worktree when its allowed scope includes it, while the protected-path guard forbids writing there. Integration still requires ordinary agent_patch inspect/apply.
certified_entry_comparisons.interfaces: createIceSubagents; IceSubagentController version1 start,stop,preview,openPatches; ICE_SUBAGENT_CONTROLLER_KEY, registerIceSubagentController,getIceSubagentController. The native ChildAgent runtime action is a different host boundary and must not be mistaken for this controller's SDK contract. SDK result {extension,bridge,attach(session),overview(),respondToApproval(id,answer)}; options {mode?,agents?,hookHandlers?,mcpAdapter?,agentDir?}.

certified_entry_comparisons.title: Subagent extension binding, session catalog refresh and lifecycle events
certified_entry_comparisons.mechanism:
The inline ice-subagents extension registers agent, agent_control and agent_patch; patch execution is sequential. Caught model-facing errors become normal text/details rather than automatically setting isError.

It registers the agents string flag and sub-yolo boolean flag, uses the current parent mode as build only when explicitly build, and combines sub-yolo input with the startup authorization contract. Settings are memoized by serialized global/project ice.subagents values and current trust. Host-pinned hook/MCP/verifier adapters are supplied through the extension options rather than arbitrary model arguments.

Parent binding follows the latest extension context and attached bridge. A shut-down-parent WeakSet prevents later callbacks from journaling against a closed parent; resume/switch rebinds to the new parent before launch. session_start invalidates configuration cache, initializes/restores runtime ownership, reconnects registry/live controls and prepares catalog/roster delivery. Startup/resume may flush persisted interruption/completion notices; a forced model turn occurs only when hasUI and pending interruption are both true. New/fork initialization does not replay another owner's work. Fork reports the count of children still owned by the original session rather than adopting them.

before_agent_start injects the incremental agent listing and, after startup/resume/compaction, a roster of the last20 depth-zero children with description prefixes80 characters. The combined catalog/roster text is not recapped as a whole. Ordinary repeat turns suppress unchanged catalog/roster data; compaction makes it eligible again. message_end confirms posted completion delivery, and session_compact/agent_settled flush pending idle deliveries. session_shutdown cancels/settles the runtime, removes controller/listener bindings and prevents stale callbacks from acquiring the departed owner. The exact durable delivery transaction and crash window are SUB-017.

Registry event serialization emits subagent_start, subagent_turn_start, subagent_turn_end (with blocked-transition exceptions), subagent_parked, subagent_revived, subagent_blocked, subagent_end, subagent_interrupted and subagent_patch; completion notification is a separate path. Events use the ice:subagent channel and metadata derived from the child record, including type,childId,agent,ownerSessionId,depth,state,optional lastTurnOutcome and optional patchState; no name or usage is added by lifecycleEvents/completionEvent. They do not include raw task prompts or raw report output; bounds come from validated contracts/record fields, not a generic serializer-wide cap.

Foreground approval presents Allow once, an offered allow-session rule, or Deny. Background requests surface through the owner inbox and event/UI notifications; no UI/inbox means deny. The view bridge exposes owner overview, approval answers, durable/live messages and stop/resume/delete/send. Runtime errors for unknown/cross-owner messages return undefined through the bridge. The command layer opens /agents hub and native definition creation. Main ice.ts loads the inline extension and MCP bridge before normal execution, with session shutdown releasing the parent MCP proxy binding.

completionEvent emits subagent_completion_queued with state=idle and the completion outcome. The extension separately emits subagent_permission_request with depth=0,state=blocked and the requested tool after in-memory per-request announcement suppression. The lifecycle union permits both, but lifecycleEvents alone does not emit them.
certified_entry_comparisons.interfaces: iceSubagentsV2(ice, IceSubagentsOptions); agent/agent_control/agent_patch registration; --agents and --sub-yolo; /agents; ice:subagent lifecycle events; session_start,before_agent_start,message_end,session_compact,agent_settled,session_shutdown listeners; view/controller binding cleanup.

certified_entry_comparisons.title: Bounded child view bridge, historical transcripts and live input control
certified_entry_comparisons.mechanism:
IceAgentViewBridge distinguishes parent, live subagent and historical-subagent descriptors, with mirror and controlled modes. Live entries take precedence over matching history.

Known display IDs may be selected/cycled; switching releases previous control. Taking control requires a live working control object; sending interactive input requires controlled mode. Historical views are always read-only. Parent replacement returns display to parent and releases control, but setParentSession does not itself clear the historical map. Disconnect releases controls/live bindings; it is not a claim that every history/control-source reference is erased. Owner checks are enforced by the supplied runtime source, not by arbitrary descriptor IDs alone.

Historical snapshots clone/redact/deep-freeze at most the last96 source messages, skipping a message over16KiB and stopping at an aggregate256KiB. Sensitive key names and credential-looking strings are redacted; cycles are redacted. Source message indices are remapped into the retained subset. Retain at most32 historical children with oldest-history eviction and accompanying UI state cleanup. Parent transcript query returns undefined; child transcript retrieval prefers live bounded messages, then the durable runtime control source, then historical snapshots. Observer exceptions are swallowed, unknown display IDs fail softly, overview source errors yield undefined, and subscribers receive updates without being allowed to break the runtime.

Presentation fields are separately bounded: task/summary/diagnostic text16KiB; up to16 labels at4096 bytes and64 evidence paths at4096; safe message indexes through1000000; marker lists through4096; retry attempts1..64 and delays<=600000ms; runtime activity tail12 with bounded tool/path/action/error text, safe elapsed/count/usage values and exit status<=65535. Runtime attention is advisory and lifetimeDeadline is false. Tool transport redacted four numeric assignment source lines during this audit; surrounding guards and tests establish bounded nonnegative usage projection, but the hidden expressions are not independently quoted or reconstructed.

SubagentLiveSessionRegistry stores frozen entries keyed by run ID, normalizes semantic colors/presentation, publishes a frozen list and catches listener failures. Replacing an entry is allowed; an old unregister callback removes it only if its session is still the registered instance. Check-in state updates affect advisory UI attention without changing execution status.

The base control tracks working→awaiting-finalization→final-report-requested→final-report-received→terminal and controlled/steered/pending-input state. Finalization waits until uncontrolled with no pending interactive input; terminal releases waiters. Base followUp rejects while controlled, marks steering and calls session.steer. Interactive steer uses session.prompt with interactive source and streamingBehavior=steer only when currently streaming, and decrements pending state in finally. Active V2 overlays stopRuntime with runtime.stop and followUp with runtime.send(...,"followup"); do not describe the base followUp implementation as the live V2 follow-up path. The formatted text transcript uses a redacted48KiB prefix of the last96 messages, rendering text/thinking and tool-call labels.
certified_entry_comparisons.interfaces: IceAgentViewBridge parent/live/history sources, requestDisplay/cycle/take-control/send/release, getSubagentOverview/respondToSubagentApproval/getSubagentMessages/control; SubagentLiveSessionRegistry register/list/subscribe/updateCheckInState; createSubagentLiveSessionControl and runtime attention/presentation types.

certified_entry_comparisons.title: Agent Hub roster, child inspector and scoped approval controls
certified_entry_comparisons.mechanism:
HubSource supplies rows, capacity, approvals, selected-child details, focus/stop/resume/delete/respond and subscriptions. Active rows appear before parked rows, preserving registry order within groups; selection follows the same child ID when it moves groups.

Initial selection prefers the first child awaiting approval. Parked children display as finished with their last outcome and Enter resumes before focusing; a child with no live view leaves the Hub open with a notice.

Approvals are scoped to the selected child. Requests follow child roster order, then oldest request within that child; the next-approval key cycles across this sequence. Allow-once, allow-session and deny target only the selected request; allow-session requires an offered rule. If another child owns the request, the selected child cannot accidentally answer it. The view ignores the boolean response return, so a raced/stale rejection can still yield an Approved-style local notice; runtime acceptance is authoritative.

Up/down move selection, confirm/attach focus, stop/delete call async runtime actions with notices, resume opens a parked child and Escape/hub key closes. Key names are read from the user's keybindings. Runtime changes request render; dispose unsubscribes. Exceptions from async actions are rendered as notices rather than silently closing the view.

At width>=110 render a55-percent roster beside an inspector; otherwise stack them. Window the roster to14 child rows around selection with above/below counts. The child name/agent/state columns use bounded visible-width formatting, and counts distinguish running/queued/idle/finished with capacity shown once. Running uses an accented dot, queued an open dot, blocked a warning exclamation, failed/abandoned a failure cross, timed-out/incomplete/budget-exhausted warning, cancelled/interrupted a square and completed a check. Other states use an open circle. Details and approval summaries appear in the selected inspector. The oneRow helper replaces line breaks and applies terminal-width truncation; it does not strip every possible terminal control/ANSI sequence. The14-row roster window is not a hard cap on total Hub height because inspector detail/request rows may be longer.
certified_entry_comparisons.interfaces: AgentHubView Component render/handleInput/dispose; HubRow,HubSource,statusMark. Source actions stay runtime-owned and approvals use ApprovalAnswer. Ordinary TUI keybinding/theme/width primitives are prerequisites, not new subagent authority. Consumed keybindings: tui.select.cancel/up/down/confirm, app.agents.hub/nextApproval/stop/delete/approve/approveSession/deny and app.subagents.attach.

certified_entry_comparisons.title: Bounded Ruflo agent-pack conversion and generated-format incompatibility
certified_entry_comparisons.mechanism:
The pre-startup --import-agent-pack flag accepts one nonempty path in separate or equals form; a resolved value beginning with a dash is not accepted in either form. Success prints the import report and exits0 even when everything was skipped; an exception exits1.

Import scans source/.claude/agents recursively in lexical order, skips child symlinks, accepts case-insensitive .md and rejects more than128 discovered files. The root stat follows a symlink; this is not a promise that every source ancestor is nonsymlink. The target directory may be created before any candidate validates.

Skip README/index files, files over64KiB, duplicate content SHA, malformed frontmatter, missing name/description and empty body. Deduplication records the content hash before later parse checks. Slugify the foreign name to lowercase alphanumeric/hyphen, trim to56 characters, then add a ruflo prefix within64. Resolve collisions by source-relative path and then an8-hex hash suffix. Existing exact generated content is already-imported; differing content is a conflict and is not overwritten. The final write uses0600 after the existence check but not exclusive wx, leaving an external-writer race.

Map Read/read_file to read, Grep/search/search_files to grep, Find/glob/list_files to find, and ls/list to ls. Unknown tools are reported with bounded names; if no known tools remain, use the four read-only tools. Foreign metadata outside name/description/tools/model is reported unsupported, and model is ignored. The generated description uses a512-code-unit prefix, carries pack/path/content-SHA provenance and frames the body as untrusted source text. A file can appear in both imported and unsupported-metadata reporting; JSON lists are bounded by the128-file scan.

Source-read defect: nativeMarkdown unconditionally emits ice-unsafe-host-exec: allowed at ice-agent-packs.ts148. The current strict native definition parser rejects that removed key. Therefore a successfully written imported profile can be unusable in active V2 discovery; do not count this converter as a working V2 import path solely because files are created. This is established by composing the two source paths, without running an import or modifying user profiles.
certified_entry_comparisons.interfaces: importRufloAgentPack and --import-agent-pack; report includes imported/skipped paths and reasons, unsupported metadata/tool names, source hashes and collision resolution. Import creates local native-style Markdown; it performs no package/network fetch.

certified_entry_comparisons.title: Frozen task contracts and explicit quality/reviewer recommendations
certified_entry_comparisons.mechanism:
buildSubagentTaskContract takes a separate nonblank objective plus strict optional kind,deliverable,constraints,nonGoals,knownFacts and verification. Kind is explore|research|review|implement|verify, default explore.

Default deliverables respectively request bounded evidence-backed answer, research summary, file-level review, scoped implementation with observed verification or a verification report. Verification is evidence|tests|review|none, default none. All nested objects reject unsupported keys. Text is trimmed and credential-looking substrings redacted. The objective itself has no builder-specific byte maximum; callers and the rendered section impose separate bounds.

Deliverable and each constraint/non-goal are capped at1024 UTF-8 bytes; constraints/non-goals at8 each. Known facts are at most8, each with a nonduplicated ID beginning alphanumeric then alphanumeric/dot/underscore/hyphen up to64 characters and text<=2048 bytes. Verification commands are at most4 strings of512 bytes; they are declarations only and do not execute or enlarge authority. Reject malformed structures, empty trimmed strings, invalid enums and excess lengths/counts with contract_invalid or contract_oversized. Deep-freeze all nested values. Canonical hashing sorts object keys while preserving array order and yields a SHA-256 identity that changes with any contract field.

Quality mode is strict when forced, when acceptance criteria or output schema exist, or when verification mode is review. An explicitly supplied explore kind with verification none/evidence becomes explore; a defaulted kind remains standard, and other combinations are standard. Render a4096-byte UTF-8-safe section with a truncation marker and explicit no-authority framing; a large objective can consume space before later sections. The reviewer recommendation applies to implement/verify with verification none or matching high-risk terms (security, migration/migrate, refactor, shared/core infrastructure or shared runtime), unless already review verification. It recommends a review_batch-style check but does not launch it.

Active V2 only calls the builder with the task description and defaults. The quality-mode and reviewer-gate helpers have no production caller found under packages/coding-agent/src, and V2 does not register a review_batch tool. Preserve these exported library contracts as dormant capabilities rather than attributing them to V2's live acceptance/budget behavior.
certified_entry_comparisons.interfaces: SubagentTaskContract {kind,objective,deliverable,constraints,nonGoals,knownFacts,verification}; buildSubagentTaskContract,hashSubagentTaskContract,deriveSubagentQualityMode,renderSubagentTaskContractSection,recommendSubagentReviewerGate and SubagentTaskContractError.

certified_entry_comparisons.title: Bounded instruction-chain manifest and repository orientation helper
certified_entry_comparisons.mechanism:
This exported bootstrap library has no active V2 production caller in the audited src inventory. Instruction selection always considers cwd/AGENTS.md, even when roots and targets are empty; the header claim that an empty scope selects nothing is broader than the implementation.

For contained scope roots and target parent directories, walk ancestors back to cwd, deduplicate and sort relative paths. Root instructions have the root reason; shared nonroot candidates choose a deterministic lexical governing-root/target reason. Lexical escapes become omissions.

Instruction reads reject symlink components beneath the trusted cwd, open with O_NOFOLLOW where available, require a regular file and allocate at most per-file limit+1 before validating. Limits are64KiB per file,256KiB selected total and16 instruction files. Candidates are read before the selected-count/total checks, so the total selected-byte cap does not bound every attempted read combined. Missing files are skipped; over-limit/symlink/escape omissions are recorded. Store relative identifier, sourceType instruction, SHA-256, byte count, reason and untrusted_repo trust, not the instruction body.

Orientation always lists root '.', then contained explicit roots, and target parent/file metadata. It reports regular files/directories in deterministic directories-first order, skips symlink directory entries, caps each directory listing at40 and reads package.json name only through a64KiB bounded file read. The resulting text is capped at8192 UTF-8 bytes at a line boundary with a marker and includes bytes/SHA. A supplied root path that is lexically contained but itself traverses a symlink can be followed by readdirSync: this orientation branch does not run the instruction branch's symlink-component check. Do not generalize the stronger instruction loader containment to the whole helper.

Only a nonempty roots/targets input adds an orientation repo_map entry to the manifest; root AGENTS.md can still appear for empty scope. Manifest entries sort by identifier; omissions deduplicate identifier/reason, selected bytes sum, and a canonical SHA covers metadata and omissions. Deep-freeze output. Render up to4096 UTF-8 bytes with an explicit truncation marker, listing identifiers/reasons/bounds and untrusted guidance framing. Because the framing is at the end, oversized earlier entries can truncate it. The prompt helper later rereads selected instruction files and requires matching length/SHA, silently skipping a changed file; it is a separate read from the provenance snapshot.

certified_entry_comparisons.title: Legacy child model routing, captured capability identity and sampling helpers
certified_entry_comparisons.mechanism:
snapshotIceSubagentRoute stores provider, modelId and SHA of capability fields (API,base URL,reasoning/thinking mapping,input modalities,context window and max tokens), without credentials. Primary/fallback references require exact provider/model syntax, no whitespace/control and length<=256.

Candidates deduplicate in order; an explicitly excluded reference is skipped with a bounded reason. Policy denial throws instead of silently rerouting. Missing catalog entry, configured auth or required capabilities becomes a skip; capabilities require positive context/output limits, text input, optional image support and requested minimums/thinking compatibility. The parent fallback is policy/capability checked, but not passed through the candidate auth test; an excluded parent throws.

A captured route is authoritative before newly supplied primary/fallback metadata. Routing must be enabled, the captured model must remain available/authenticated and its capability hash must match, otherwise reject instead of silently rerouting. With no requested/fallback/captured route, return the exact parent identity without catalog/capability work, even when routing is disabled. Opt-in controls selection, not mere parent inheritance.

The sampling helper omits temperature for Anthropic with thinking enabled or a model that explicitly disallows temperature. It emits topP only for azure-openai-responses, openai-completions and openai-responses; unsupported values produce diagnostics. The thinking helper rejects explicitly requested unsupported levels and clamps a default level to supported capability. These helpers do not alter the parent model.

Source caller searches found only definitions/internal helper calls for resolveIceSubagentRoute/Candidates, resolveSubagentSamplingOptions and resolveSubagentThinkingLevel, with no active V2 production caller. V2 has its separate definition/model-list resolver and freezes model metadata; its session factory does not apply the stored temperature/topP. Do not claim these legacy fallback/sampling checks currently run for every V2 child.
certified_entry_comparisons.interfaces: IceSubagentRouteSnapshot {provider,modelId,capabilityHash}; snapshotIceSubagentRoute,resolveIceSubagentCandidates,resolveIceSubagentRoute; resolveSubagentSamplingOptions,resolveSubagentThinkingLevel. Runtime model/auth/policy capabilities are caller-supplied; no auth command or network lookup is performed by these pure selectors.

certified_entry_comparisons.title: Legacy fork prompt identity, report validation and schema-v1 report artifacts
certified_entry_comparisons.mechanism:
deriveSubagentPromptCacheKey returns a key only for fork context. Canonical serialization sorts object keys, preserves array order and has explicit handling of undefined.

It hashes captured model route, prompt/profile, scope, execution authority, resources, context packets, fork messages and MCP/adapter metadata; delegated task text is excluded. The key is ice-fork-v1- plus52 hex characters. This is fork cache identity, not a permission token.

buildSubagentPrompt composes handoff and selected context/resource/provenance/task/scoped-target/report sections, labels inherited repository material untrusted and explains unsafe-host constraints. Selected prompt content is parsed as frontmatter/body, trimmed and redacted; that loader is reused by active V2 resources. Instruction-manifest content is reread from a contained nonsymlink leaf and accepted only on exact byte count/SHA; mismatch silently omits it. No new aggregate cap is imposed by this reread helper. buildUnsafeSubagentSystemPrompt advertises the captured tool allowlist and lack of host sandboxing, but prose is not the enforcement boundary. Fork transcript sanitization occurs upstream.

Legacy verifySubagentResult checks lineage/run/profile/source/status/child identity, partial state and output materialization. A bounded plain result can be verified=true in this legacy type even though no structured evidence was checked; active V2 uses unverified plain output. Legacy structured evidence validates path existence and scope, not observations from successful tools in the current child turn. Required satisfied criteria may accept an explicitly empty evidencePaths array because the generic all-path check is vacuous; V2 requires nonempty observed evidence. Repair/wrap-up/final-report prompt builders are library helpers and do not establish automatic V2 repair behavior.

writeSubagentReportArtifact uses schemaVersion1 with an absolute file path, distinct from V2's opaque schemaVersion2 owned output UUID. Require a nonempty raw report and a run ID of1..128 alphanumeric/dot/underscore/hyphen characters. Redact then keep a UTF-8 prefix up to512KiB. Store under agentDir/artifacts/subagent/<runId>/report.txt or report.json; reject symlink components, require a new private0700 run directory and an exclusive no-follow regular file, then chmod0444. This helper does not fsync, refuses an existing run directory and returns undefined on failure, potentially leaving an orphan directory. truncateSubagentOutput is a UTF-8 prefix without a marker. extractAssistantText selects the most recent assistant at/after the supplied index and concatenates text blocks, which can be empty.

Caller searches found no production invocation of the fork key, full legacy prompt, legacy verifier or schema-v1 writer under src. Only the selected-content and several small shared utilities are reused. The active V2 result verifier/artifact store is specified separately in SUB-027/028.
certified_entry_comparisons.interfaces: deriveSubagentPromptCacheKey,buildSubagentPrompt,buildAcceptanceCriteriaContract,truncateSubagentOutput,writeSubagentReportArtifact,extractAssistantText; legacy verifySubagentResult and repair/finalization prompt helpers. Schema-v1 absolute-path artifacts must not be accepted as schema-v2 opaque references.

certified_entry_comparisons.title: Declarative environment/path/command preflight helper
certified_entry_comparisons.mechanism:
Normalize at most8 requirements with nonblank values<=512 characters, ID<=64 characters using the allowed alphanumeric/dot/underscore/hyphen form, kind command|path|env-present and required default true unless explicitly false. The normalizer rejects malformed fields and duplicates but does not reject every unknown input key. The result is declarative metadata, not a tool grant.

Command values must be bare executable names using alphanumeric/dot/underscore/plus/hyphen, with no path separator or shell syntax. Search nonempty PATH directories for a regular executable file using X_OK; no command runs, no shell parsing and no Windows PATHEXT expansion are performed. Environment checks use own-property presence rather than truthiness, so a present property with undefined still counts PRESENT; neither response nor summary includes the value. Path checks use lexical containment in approved roots and existence checks that can follow symlinks; they do not prove canonical containment.

Checks return FOUND/UNAVAILABLE for command, PRESENT/ABSENT for env and corresponding path availability or OUT_OF_SCOPE. Required unsuccessful checks block; optional failures do not. Formatting includes redacted, per-item bounded identifiers/values/status/reason and no separate global aggregate byte cap beyond normalized item limits. The full caller search found no active V2 production call to evaluateSubagentPreflight; the V2 launch validation in SUB-018 is a distinct live path.
certified_entry_comparisons.interfaces: normalizeSubagentPreflightRequirements,evaluateSubagentPreflight,formatSubagentPreflight,formatSubagentPreflightFailure; SubagentPreflightRequirement/Input/Check/Evaluation and state enum. The caller supplies cwd/approved roots/environment/PATH.

certified_entry_comparisons.title: Shared child activity, hook flushing, lifecycle races and legacy error envelopes
certified_entry_comparisons.mechanism:
Activity digests pick a path from path,file_path,filePath,root,cwd, display only lexically scoped paths and use redacted compact action text. General activity text has a192-byte prefix before adding an ellipsis, so the final marker can exceed that nominal prefix cap; grep text uses96 and final status256. argsDigest is a16-hex SHA over JSON serialization, whose input serialization is not itself bounded. Bash exit status prefers a safe integer details value0..65535; otherwise a trailing numeric status expression can also match a timeout duration, so that fallback is not an independently observed process exit status.

Hook decision dispatch is awaited and uses the configured bounded dispatcher. Observation dispatch retains promises/controllers without delaying the tool path; flush waits up to2000ms, aborts remaining controllers and then awaits the pending promises. The final await is not an independent hard deadline if a supplied dispatcher remains uncooperative; the ordinary dispatcher has its own deadline. Disposal and scope changes must prevent observations from being applied to another child/turn. Active V2 tool observations/evidence rules are SUB-015/027 and bounded hook decisions are SUB-011.

abortChildSession races abort against a1000ms grace. Shutdown emits the session shutdown event and disposes in finally. awaitSubagentStartup races a startup promise with cancellation/deadline and leaves resource cleanup to its caller; a timeout result alone is not proof that underlying work ended. Context-packet normalization rejects malformed/oversized items and canonically deduplicates, with base packet entries winning a merge. Active V2's packet authority and limits are SUB-025.

The legacy SubagentError helpers classify19 error codes with retryability, bounded hints, optional path/task context and normalized tool-error details. They are not the active V2 three-tool error envelope, whose caught errors are usually ordinary text/details. Do not infer retry behavior or isError flags from this exported legacy type. Preserve exact classes and caller reachability when porting shared utilities, and retain the stronger native cleanup accounting described below.
